fixList.title: Add description field to CreateEvent form
fixList.description: The DB requires a `description` field but the form doesn't have it. Event creation will fail.
fixList.suggested_fix: Add to formSchema around line 38: `description: z.string().min(10, 'Description must be at least 10 characters')`, add Textarea form field, and include in eventData object

fixList.title: Call validateBannerFile() before upload
fixList.description: validateBannerFile function exists but is never called. Invalid files can be uploaded.
fixList.suggested_fix: In onChange handler: `onChange={(e) => { const file = e.target.files?.[0]; if (file && validateBannerFile(file)) { onChange(e.target.files); } }}`

fixList.title: Add registration_opens and registration_closes fields
fixList.description: DB schema requires these fields but form doesn't collect them.
fixList.suggested_fix: Add two date picker fields similar to event_starts/event_ends, set defaults (e.g., registration_opens = now, registration_closes = event_starts)

fixList.title: Add error handling for orphan cleanup
fixList.description: storage.remove() call may fail silently, leaving orphan files
fixList.suggested_fix: Wrap cleanup in try-catch, log errors, consider retry logic or background cleanup job

fixList.title: Show bannerError state in UI
fixList.description: bannerError state is set but never displayed to users
fixList.suggested_fix:
Add {bannerError &&

{bannerError}

} after the file input

fixList.title: Add aria-describedby to form inputs
fixList.description: Improve accessibility by linking inputs to their descriptions
fixList.suggested_fix: Add aria-describedby attributes pointing to FormDescription elements
